policy: Every agent, bot, session class and evaluator that acts for Jovie is listed with its principals, credential names (never values), allowed actions, boundaries, audit trail, agent owner and mesh binding. Shared or borrowed identities carry a tracked least-privilege fix; credential changes stay with Tim. Live drift: node scripts/ownership-registry.mjs --live.

flags.SUMMER_MESH_INBOX_ENABLED: gates accept/read/ACK; documented only, never changed by this registry

summer.name: Summer
allowedActions: create Linear issues and coordinate admission
boundaries: startup refuses DATABASE_URL, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, JOVIE_*TOKEN, BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (agent/lib/application-boundary.ts)
SUMMER_PACK denies privileged gbrain write and Symphony heal (apps/web/lib/ovie/identity.ts)
intended Linear grant read,issues:create only

mesh.tokenBinding: host of SUMMER_MESH_INBOX_REGISTRY / SUMMER_MESH_PEER_REGISTRY; SUMMER_MESH_INBOX_ENABLED gates the inbox (not changed)
mesh.audit: summer-company/mesh-inbox/* Blob receipts on summer.jov.ie (mailbox reads + ACKs)

sharing.detail: Linear writer is a static orchestration token not proven to be Summer's own app actor; the Ovie door writes Linear with the product LINEAR_API_KEY.

ovie.name: Ovie (founder door)
allowedActions: relay founder decisions to their domain endpoints
boundaries: JOVIE_PACK denies every capability (apps/web/lib/ovie/identity.ts)
Eve may never dispatch, execute code or broaden permissions (apps/web/lib/ovie/eve-authority.ts)

sharing.detail: A door onto Summer's identity by design (FLEET.md: not a second soul).
